blockers.text: The only point-in-time NFL weather-forecast archive (nfl-edge-finder context-capture.yml -> market-data data/context) has published nothing since 2026-10-28 and its recent runs fail. Weeks 9-11 forecasts are already lost (they cannot be backfilled). Re-running it once from the Actions tab and reading the fresh log is the cheapest fix; no new workflow is needed.

Unchanged from Phase 6 and not re-litigated: every free source of new CBB / NBA / NHL / CFB history reachable here is collection_allowed=false in rights_registry.json and the sportsdataverse college collector is frozen (owner decision 1). Phase 7 collected nothing from those sources.

The CFBD/CBBD direct-API path is built and tested (college-direct-probe.yml, 10-call cap) but needs the owner approval file (college_direct_*.json) on main and an owner dispatch; the API host is blocked from this environment.

nfl.td_luck and nfl.team_first_td_attribution name ffopportunity expected-TD fields. The release is reachable but unrecorded in the rights registry; record a reading (or reject it) before it is collected.

Of the held-but-unbuilt PIT-safe inputs, most define a fitted model or simulation (copulas, GLMMs, logit lattices) as their whole content; they can be built PARTIAL but not certified FULL without fitting that model, so they do not become training-ready from a deterministic builder.
